timing: Before author review of the current external-development QA outputs and before protected-family semantic inspection. Current development generation may already be underway.
candidate_scope: Predeclared, actually fitted operation recipes with fixed final checkpoints. Current24/36family pilot recipes remain development candidates; wider-source intake is still incomplete and must not be redefined as finished.

selection_rule.primary: Source-faithful complete-task success macro-averaged over the8external development source families. Failure, unsupported qualification and incomplete required dimensions are not full success.
selection_rule.response_rule: Judge all explicitly requested dimensions; supported representative reflection examples need not copy every authored sentence. Preserve unknowns, speaker/subject and current/planned/historical distinctions.
selection_rule.tie: Use Pareto dominance over measured generation tokens, native input tokens and full per-message wall time if one tied-quality recipe is no worse on all three; otherwise retain the smaller-data recipe as a deterministic tie-break. Report all alternatives and uncertainty.
selection_rule.original_development: The original8family slice is reported separately and used as a regression diagnostic, not substituted for the external-development criterion after seeing scores.

confirmation.checkpoint_rule: Final declared update only for every seed; never best-seed/checkpoint selection on protected outcomes.
confirmation.training_inputs: Same source split, selected representation, initialization and update recipe across seeds. Reuse an identical already-completed BASE evaluation rather than repeating its model positions.
confirmation.protected_data: Use only preallocated protected families after recipe/data/runtime freeze. Keep source_task and explicit_lifecycle tracks distinct, report actual independent family counts and broad uncertainty. Do not claim the suggested48family scale if fewer are admitted.
required_controls: simple dynamic rules with declared context-read capability
generative controller with the same operations
required_outputs: full disaggregated method computation including load/recovery
all first failures, unknown usage and partial effects

analysis.quality: Report source-faithful complete-task macro success by source family and separately by lifecycle family. Required lifecycle receipts, target unavailability and non-target preservation are additional explicit state outcomes; do not pool these tracks into an inflated source count.
analysis.seeds: Report each selected learned seed 0/1/2 and their equal-weight mean. Seeds, prefixes and repeated questions remain inside their originating source-family cluster, never independent samples.
analysis.paired_intervals: Use 20000 paired family bootstrap resamples, analysis RNG seed 0, within each track. Carry every stage, repeat and declared seed together when a family is selected. Report sparse per-family outcomes and wide intervals; no equivalence claim from an interval crossing zero.
analysis.cost_claim: No accepted quality loss is registered for an efficiency-superiority claim (margin 0). Report observed quality-cost tradeoffs descriptively. Claim cost improvement with preserved quality only if the paired quality evidence excludes degradation and the separately reported costs support improvement; otherwise retain uncertainty.
analysis.cost_components: Report generation/embedding known and unknown usage, native forwards/input tokens/CPU/wall, loads/recovery, actual read/refresh operation time and whole-message wall. Whole-message timer wraps message(), including source imports. Whole-dispatch wall and preparation overhead remain separate; nested clocks are not added twice.
analysis.research_cost: Training, label preparation, probes and author annotation are separate research costs. CPU serialization timers do not measure semantic author work.
analysis.source_exposure: Seven source-task and three explicit-lifecycle backgrounds are provisionally reserved by existing metadata. Prior preparation scanned/indexed files without model calls; they are not byte-sealed unread blobs or guaranteed pretraining-unseen. Preserve any later discovered prior evaluated exposure as regression, with no favorable replacement.
analysis.lifecycle_admission: After recipe/data/runtime freeze, inspect the three reserved lifecycle sources under the existing separation rule. Current normal Host commands must execute save/update/forget and subsequent queries; historical quoted requests and conversation claims alone are not actual lifecycle effects.

conditional_work: No automatic RL, value-model or encoder-cache platform. Additional mechanisms require evidence of the corresponding bottleneck and a separate matched comparison.
remaining: V10 baselines/own trajectories, expanded81 fit/evaluation, registered development selection, all-seed fitting and protected source/lifecycle preparation remain unfinished. Metadata-only analysis registration does not admit protected bodies or establish completion.
analysis_registration_timing: Detailed aggregation/cost criteria added after partial external-development reviews but before any protected semantic inspection, selected recipe/runtime freeze or confirmation generation. Original recipe-selection rule unchanged.
